answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake and emit a signed heartbeat pulse every epoch, checked against a quartz-stable hardware clock so one identity cannot be replayed in two places. New agents also need sponsorship from established peers, who may sponsor only a few newcomers per epoch. Reputation flows like a river, earned slowly through attested work and lost at once on fraud. An attacker must fund a stake, win sponsorship, and sustain heartbeats for every fake identity, so mass forgery costs far more than honest participation.
